desc: Saturation-prepared with 2 rapid gradient echoes (SA2RAGE) uses a ratio of two saturation recovery images with different time delays, and a simulated look-up table to estimate B1+ ([Eggenschwiler et al. 2011](https://doi.org/10.1002/mrm.23145)). This sequence can also be used in conjunction with MP2RAGE T1 mapping to iteratively improve B1+ and T1 map estimation ([Marques & Gruetter 2013](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0069294)). Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.
